title: WaterColor 1785 E. County Hwy 30A #302
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:*Per Watercolor HOA, please include all guests aged 5 and older in your total count of adult guests to receive amenity and pool access wristbands. Sleep arrangements are provided as a courtesy and are not considered in the occupancy count.**This home is allowed 4 amenity access bands.**- Gulf views- Comfortable furnished patio- Washer/Dryer- Smart TVs- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout Guests staying in WaterColor will have access to the newly expanded WaterColor Beach Club. It features a new main pool and lounge area, second pool deck with additional lounge seating, and third pool with zero-entry, as well an enhanced WaterColor Grill, and new sunset bar, Costa Chica. All have scenic views of the Gulf of Mexico.DETAILS: Unit #302 is a 2-story condo with Gulf views that sleeps 4. This 1-bedroom with loft WaterColor condo is in the heart of the beach district. Guests will love the renovated interiors' glamorous feel and being mere steps from the Beach Club, restaurants, and our white-sand beaches. Serene white interiors, sea breezes, and Gulf views provide a restful backdrop for neutral furnishings dotted with aquamarine accents, modern artwork, and luxe fabrics. New floors give the unit a refreshed feel. The kitchen has stainless steel appliances, a sea-glass blue tile backsplash, and a high-top dark granite bar overlooking a light-filled living and dining area. During meals, guests can enjoy Gulf views at a dining table that seats 6. A wide armchair that folds out to a twin and 2 sofas surround a large smart TV in the living area. A hammered silver table, and blue velvet throw pillows add a dash of movie star glam. Guests can walk out to a Gulf-front balcony through a door in the living area. The balcony furniture includes a wooden bench, a high-top wooden table with four captain chairs, and two beachy Adirondack chairs. A lovely primary bedroom off the dining area also opens to the balcony. Guests can enjoy Gulf views from the king bed, catch up on work at a dainty marble-top desk, and get ready for a night out in a private bathroom with a vanity and glass-enclosed shower. A traditional wood staircase leads from the living area to an adorable loft space with a built-in full and twin bed. Guests in the loft have a shared 1st floor bathroom with a shower/tub combo. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:- Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower Only- Living Room: Twin Sleeper Chair- Loft: Full Bed and Twin Bed, Shared Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboWATERCOLOR NEIGHBORHOOD HIGHLIGHTS:- Named the #1 Family Vacation Destination in the U.S.- A 499-acre coastal resort and residential community- Ideal bike community perfect for Family Getaways- Pristine sugar sand beaches- 6 swimming pools- Award-winning tennis facilities- Championship golf nearby- World Famous Beach Club- Unparalleled beachside, poolside, and lakeside dining- Acres of parks, gardens, and footpaths- Nearby state parks and preserves*Weddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments, as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.Please note: Effective January 11th 2024, Watercolor Community HOA will no longer allow Low-Speed Vehicles to be rented by guests staying in the Town Center Condos.
